entries.core/pythonlib/filesystem.py::ObjectsDum: Interface conformance: ObjectsAndFilesProcessor._process_object declares verbose and process_objects() passes it to every override; the caller, not the override, does the verbose logging (filesystem.py:171).
entries.core/pythonlib/filesystem.py::ObjectsLoa: Interface conformance: same abstract signature as ObjectsDumper._process_object; the verbose logging lives in the calling process_objects() loop.
entries.data/pandaslib/dtypes.py::get_df_memory_: Deprecated public parameter, documented in the docstring as kept for backward compatibility and ignored; removing it would break positional callers.
entries.dev/code_audit/domain_boundary.py::scan_: Scanner-registry uniformity: every registered scanner takes (root, exclude_dirs); this one names each boundary file explicitly and never walks a tree. Documented in its own Args section.
entries.dev/code_audit/missed_await.py::_Blockin: ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: the visitor stops traversal at a nested scope, so the node is deliberately not descended into.
ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: the visitor stops traversal at a nested scope, so the node is deliberately not descended into.
ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: the visitor stops traversal at a nested lambda scope, so the node is deliberately not descended into.
entries.dev/code_audit/return_annotation.py::_Ow: ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: returns without descending, so a nested function's returns are not attributed to the outer one.
ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: returns without descending, so a nested function's returns are not attributed to the outer one.
ast.NodeVisitor dispatch signature: returns without descending, so a nested lambda's returns are not attributed to the outer function.
entries.llm/base.py::LLMProvider._classify_batch: Base-class hook returning None for the generic path; subclasses (GeminiProvider) inspect exc to tag safety blocks. Documented as a hook in its docstring.
entries.llm/claude_code_provider.py::ClaudeCodeP: LLMProvider.estimate_cost interface conformance; Claude Code is billed by subscription so the cost is $0 regardless of token counts.
LLMProvider.estimate_cost interface conformance; Claude Code is billed by subscription so the cost is $0 regardless of token counts.
entries.llm/gemini_provider.py::_is_retryable_ge: ImportError fallback stub for the real predicate above it: with google.genai absent there is nothing to classify, and the signature must match the version used when the SDK is present.
entries.llm/openai_compat.py::OpenAICompatiblePr: Base-class hook: the OpenAI-family default is reasoning-included-in-completion, so only completion_tokens is billed; xAI's override adds reasoning_tokens.
Base-class hook returning vanilla OpenAI-compatible behaviour (no extra fields); OpenRouter's override uses model for routing options.
Base-class hook returning a flat 120s default; per-model timeouts are an override's job (OpenRouter keys off model).
Base-class hook: vanilla OpenAI-compatible upstreams have no thinking-mode field, so the default returns None; subclasses normalise thinking to their own schema.
Documented no-op hook; OpenRouter's override reads data for generation id / upstream provider / resolved model.
Documented no-op hook; OpenRouter's override reads usage.cost.
entries.llm/openai_provider.py::OpenAIProvider._: Override kept explicit for the same base-class hook signature: OpenAI bills reasoning inside completion_tokens, so the extra count must NOT be added.
entries.llm/openrouter_provider/_provider.py::Op: Base-class hook signature; OpenRouter's routing options (provider order/ignore, model fallback list) are instance configuration and do not vary by model.
entries.performance/kernel_tuning/cache/cache_ho: TuningHooks protocol conformance; the default logger reports kernel+dims only, deliberately not the (potentially large) region payload.
entries.performance/kernel_tuning/cache/cache_tu: Retained for signature stability after the sweep-locking rework and documented as such at cache_tuning.py:164; the wait is now bounded by the lock implementation itself.
entries.performance/kernel_tuning/code_versionin: Cache-key-only argument: the lru_cache is keyed on (fn, code_key) so a bytecode swap invalidates the entry. Participating in the key IS its purpose; reading it in the body would be meaningless.
entries.system/gpu_dispatch.py::_select_best_gpu: Cache-key-only argument, documented in the docstring: pid is in the lru_cache key so a fork resets the memoised device selection.
entries.text/similarity/_numba_api.py::SentenceS: Pure-Python fallback class used when numba is absent; the signature must match the numba-accelerated class it replaces.
entries.text/similarity/_numba_api.py::sentences: Pure-Python fallback used when numba is absent; the signature must match the numba-accelerated version, which is the one that can actually parallelise.
entries.text/similarity/basics.py::normalize_sen: Superseded public parameter, now documented in the docstring as ignored: sports club-suffix handling moved to the caller-supplied abbreviations list. Kept so positional callers keep working.
entries.text/strings/jsonutils.py::_PreSerialize: psycopg2 Json adapter interface: psycopg2 calls dumps(obj), but this adapter wraps text that was already serialised, so obj is what adapted parses FROM. Documented in the docstring.
entries.text/tokenizers.py::AdvancedTokenizer.to: Legacy signature, now documented in the docstring as ignored: corpus statistics accumulate onto this instance's own counters via tokenize(), never into a caller-supplied dict.
entries.web/web/config.py::connect::kwargs: Deliberate **kwargs sink so a caller forwarding a wider settings dict is not rejected; only the m_* names are configuration this function owns.
